comparison: Each Rare battle/support pair shares the same 15-card pool, opponent pool, battle count, and player/CPU side assignment. Sword Saint battle comparison aggregates the five lineup sizes; its support cohort has the same lineup-size proportions. Opponent battle count matches the listed Sword Saint lineup size.
ai: history-weighted RPS scoring with card ability and damage-table values; contextual support selection; same table-aware reroll heuristic for both sides; strongest revived candidate. Engine owns all outcomes.
limits: KO successor selection follows the existing engine fixed cyclic slot order; the prototype has no player choice at KO.
Support policy uses heuristic values and is an evaluation AI, not an optimal strategy.
No browser rendering or user-input timing is simulated; all battle states and rules resolve through BattleEngine.

comparisonAudit.note: Historical 56,000-match figures were generated before exact paired roster swapping. Treat Rare battle/support win-rate differences as confounded by other own battle-card identities and combat RNG. The simulator source now defines exact paired setups for a future run; this audit did not run it.

supportUseScope: Per-match support uses and unused support counts sum both player and CPU.
